drhp.business: ARCL Organics operates in the formaldehyde derivatives and thermosetting-resins value chain, producing formaldehyde, phenolic resins, amino resins, melamine resins, hardeners, specialised one-shot resins and customer-specific chemical solutions. Its products serve plywood and wood panels, laminates, furniture and adhesives, textiles, paper and other process industries.

drhp.expansion: During FY2025-26, ARCL strengthened its manufacturing footprint through the acquisition of the existing running unit of Vishvam Formalin and Angel Resins at Kadadra, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, adding 49,500 TPA of Formaldehyde and around 60,000 TPA of Resins. This unit already holds environment clearance for Paraformaldehyde and Hexamine as well, which management expects will eventually help double the Company's existing turnover.

litigation.note: Pending litigation in the matter of Direct & Indirect taxes and other taxes incidental to business and operations, per the Secretarial Audit Report (Annexure B); separately, during the year the Company settled a long-pending customs dues dispute from pre-amalgamation entity Allied Resins & Chemicals Ltd, legacy income tax arrears from the 1988-1998 block period under Vivad Se Vishwas 2.0, and municipal tax dues after withdrawing litigation at Calcutta High Court (Chairman's Message).
